calledthe“KingLeopoldglaciation”(Williams,2004,2005),that

continents(Crowell,1999),andastrongatmosphericgreenhouse gestedalowpalaeolatitude(<20◦)fortheKingLeopoldglaciation,
effect was postulated for that interval (Pavlov et al., 2003). The comparablewiththelowpalaeolatitudesdeterminedforotherPro-
